objects.taxonomy_description: Fabric bag with two parallel shoulder straps for carrying on the back. The main compartment is a rectangular or rounded pouch (30-55 cm tall) made of nylon, canvas, or polyester with a zipper or drawstring closure. External features include side pockets, front organizer pockets, and compression straps. The back panel has padded shoulder straps that converge at the top and a reinforced grab handle. Materials range from smooth synthetic fabric to textured canvas. Colors vary widely. The bag exhibits bilateral symmetry with straps positioned symmetrically on the back panel.

objects.taxonomy_description: Time-telling device designed for wall mounting with a circular face 20-40 cm in diameter. Face features hour numerals (Arabic, Roman, or markers) arranged in a 12-hour circle. Two or three hands (hour, minute, second) rotate from the center. Frame is wood, metal, or plastic in various finishes (oak, black, white, brass). Mounting bracket or keyhole slot on the back. Quartz movement powered by a single AA battery. Glass or plastic crystal covers the face. Some models have a pendulum visible below the face. Overall depth is 5-10 cm.

objects.taxonomy_description: The giraffe is distinguished by its exceptionally long neck and legs, ossicones on the head, and a coat pattern of irregular patches.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length: Possesses an extremely elongated neck that is significantly longer than the body length.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Leg_Proportion: Features disproportionately long and slender legs compared to other ungulates.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Cranial_Appendages: Has short, skin-covered, horn-like structures called ossicones on top of the head.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coat_Pattern: Displays a distinct coat with large, irregular brownish patches separated by lighter lines.
